mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 35 degrees with clear skies by the Verona Public Library and we are seeing a first quarter moon.
The city is hosting a public information meeting on December 8th at the Senior Center to discuss the Military Ridge State Trail paving project, which includes bridge replacements and detours.
There is plenty to do with trivia today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and yoga sessions happening tomorrow.
Looking at the recent police activity, officers arrested a 31-year-old woman for O W I on November 6th after responding to a welfare check at a local business.
Treat yourself to today's flavor of the day, Caramel Turtle, as the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
